title_en: One Day, Several Sets of Wheels

captions.en: Leaving home, powered entirely by optimism.

captions.zh: 今天的动力，全靠昨天的饭。
captions.en: My engine runs on yesterday's dinner.

captions.zh: 腿累了，给自己换个引擎。
captions.en: My legs requested an engine upgrade.

captions.zh: 换了四个轮子，还是得看路。
captions.en: Four wheels now. Same talent for waiting.

captions.zh: 终于下车，打工模式启动。
captions.en: Out of the car. Into employee mode.

captions.zh: 过了这条街，就该认真了。
captions.en: One crossing away from looking productive.
I clocked in. Reality switched to simulation.

captions.zh: 机器人搬砖，我负责走流程。
captions.en: Robots move boxes. I move between tasks.

captions.zh: 同事的执行力，主要体现在腿上。
captions.en: My colleague really puts the run in running operations.

captions.zh: 出来透口气，大家还在赶路。
captions.en: Fresh air. Everyone else is still rushing.

captions.zh: 歇一会儿，城市替我继续忙。
captions.en: Taking a break while the city keeps working.

captions.zh: 收工，还是两个轮子最踏实。
captions.en: Back to two wheels. At least they understand me.

captions.zh: 换了几种车，没换掉打工人。
captions.en: Different wheels. Same commuter. See you tomorrow.
